description: Mongo Q2 (spec 3.2), also the 'top contested pages' comparison query: the top 20 contested pages of the history cohort, with the shared definition of DATA_MODEL.md section 7. revert_actions = distinct reverting_rev_id among revert_links with within_followup and by_other on the page; reverted_editors = distinct author_key among those links; edits = non-bot history revisions on the page (from revisions, with $lookup on page.id). Pages need edits >= 10 and reverted_editors >= 2. score = revert_actions / edits (a float). Order: score desc, revert_actions desc, edits desc, page_id asc. contested = revert_actions >= 2 and score >= 0.2. It starts from revert_links, because only pages with reverts can qualify, and the $lookup then uses the {page.id, ts} index. How to run it by hand: in Atlas, open Data Explorer, pick the database 'truthlag' and the collection 'revert_links', open the Aggregations tab, switch to the text view (the '</>' button) and paste the 'pipeline' array. In MongoDB Compass: open the collection 'revert_links', Aggregations, Text, then paste the array. In mongosh: db.revert_links.aggregate(<pipeline>). Do not edit this file by hand: queries/run_mongo.py writes it from config.py.
